A. Phase 55 Overview

Phase 55 quantifies whether attention heads within the same encoder layer of the Final Transformer learn non-identical temporal-allocation patterns, using only frozen Phase 54 last-query-attention artifacts. This is a descriptive, behavioral comparison only. No best-head is selected, no head is pruned, and no error-conditioned or cross-seed analysis is performed here.

C. Comparison Scope

Primary unit: (seed, layer, head_a, head_b) with head_a &lt; head_b. Comparison is ONLY within the same seed AND within the same layer. No comparison across different seeds. No comparison across different layers as if they shared the same parameter set. Same-index heads across seeds are NOT assumed to be semantically equivalent. Same-index heads across layers are NOT assumed to be the same parameter set.

G. Top1 Lag Distribution Comparison (TVD + JSD)

Top1 lag = source position with maximum single attention weight (Phase 52 NEWEST_SOURCE tie rule preserved). TVD = Total Variation Distance; JSD = Jensen-Shannon divergence on the top1 frequency distribution. TVD range [0, 1]: 0 = identical, 1 = disjoint distributions. JSD range [0, ln(2)]: 0 = identical, ln(2) = disjoint. These compare which lags most attract the single maximum weight, NOT the full probability mass distribution.

M. Scientific Caveats

ATTENTION IS NOT FEATURE IMPORTANCE
Attention weights describe temporal-allocation patterns. They do not directly measure feature relevance or importance for prediction.
ATTENTION IS NOT CAUSAL
Observed attention behavior does not establish a causal relationship between attention allocation and prediction outcomes.
HIGH SIMILARITY != FUNCTIONAL REDUNDANCY
Two heads with nearly identical attention profiles can still output different values because their value (V) projections differ. Phase 55 only describes attention-allocation redundancy.
SAME INDEX ACROSS SEEDS != SEMANTIC ALIGNMENT
Head 1 in seed 42 and Head 1 in seed 123 are different parameter sets. Phase 55 does not assume semantic equivalence.
SAME INDEX ACROSS LAYERS != SAME HEAD
Layer 0 Head 1 and Layer 1 Head 1 are different parameter sets. No cross-layer identity assumption is made.
NO BEST-HEAD / NO PRUNING
Phase 55 does not select a best head, does not prune heads, and does not authorize any head ablation.
NO POST-HOC REDUNDANCY THRESHOLD
Redundancy is reported descriptively (e.g., JSD=0.018, cosine=0.97). No threshold such as 'JSD &lt; 0.02 = redundant' is invented.
12h/24h RECENCY WINDOWS MAY BE TRUNCATED
With lookback L=72 steps (720 min = 12h), the '24h' window is not fully supported. Only 1h and 6h windows are fully within lookback.
